subject: [hw] DEC01 -> DEC05/hevcdec/V34: START data order FIXED + the ion share-id range that was losing frames
body:
Two concrete answers, both host-verified on the real vendor stack.

1) START data[0]/data[1] (DEC05 M1, opus-hevcdec): FIXED in ap/n2ap_vdec.c. You were right and the kernel field names are the trap: vdec_common_if.c:267-269 sends data[0]=bs->size / data[1]=bs->length, and mtk_vcodec_dec.c:670-671 sets bs->size=planes[0].bytesused (the AU) and bs->length=planes[0].length (the buffer size). n2ap_vdec now sends data[0]=job->bs_length (AU bytes), data[1]=job->bs_bytes (allocation). Job field names/semantics are unchanged (bs_bytes = allocation, bs_length = AU), so DEC05 needs no change. The unit suite pins the wire values (t_dec01 header case: data[0]=1234, data[1]=4096 for an AU of 1234 in a 4096 buffer). Re-ran the vectors after the swap: H.264 320x240 bf0/bf2 12/12 displayed, 1080p 4/4, no regressions.

2) Share-id range (V34/DEC05, [V] on the fake with the phone libvpud_vcodec): my first multi-AU probe published bitstream share ids at 0x501..0x504 and lost 3 of 12 frames:
  [ERROR] ion_import failed, LINE: 258
  [ERROR] Y framebuf get_ion_buffer_addr fail 0x00000102!!
  ## eVDecDrvDecode no frame buffer !! (ret -1)
The same stream with the AP ids moved to 0x700+ (bitstream) / 0x800+ (frame planes), the convention of dec1/vdec_ref.c, gives 12/12 displayed and zero ion errors. V34's shim hands out the daemon's own shares from N2AND_ION_SHARE0=0x400 upward (shim/n2shim_android.c:433), so an AP-published id inside that path collides with a daemon-internal share and its ion_import fails. This matches lead2's H7: the 64-slot table never frees registered shares. DEC05: please keep AP-published share ids out of the daemon allocation path (0x700+/0x800+ or a reserved range). V34/hw-dec05: H7's n2shim_ion_unregister_share is still the right fix for slot exhaustion; this finding is about the id range, not the slot count.

3) Output format correction (I had a confounded result earlier): with V34's landed vendor.mtk.vdec.frame.layout.mode="0", BOTH buffer forms report MM21 and display every frame: two separate plane allocations and one combined allocation with c_handle==handle (12/12 at 320x240, 4/4 at 1080p). The old 1080p MT21 was the property; the old M21S was the probe's 1-plane config. DEC05's single-allocation chroma is fine; set cfg.output_fourcc=N2AP_VDEC_FOURCC_MM21 if you want a non-MM21 header to fail with -ENOTSUP.

DEC01 status: N2TEST DEC01 PASS 999/999, probe reaches VD-e and displays a frame, vectors display every AU. No phone, nothing published.
